title: Deficiency Balance Quotes on the Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
**Servicing desk reference — deficiency balance quotes, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

A deficiency quote states what a customer whose repossessed vehicle has been sold at auction still owes on the contract, as of the quote date. It is produced when the customer asks for the deficiency balance, and its good-through date is the quote validity period for the tier after the quote date.

For a deficiency quote, and only for such a quote, the figure is worked out under the deficiency terms of the Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract. A redemption quote is figured under the redemption-quote terms, and every other payoff quote is the principal balance plus the fees due balance plus the per diem, rounded to the cent, times the days from the day after the interest-paid-to date through the good-through date.

**Prerequisite.** For an involuntary recovery, the deficiency figure is not stated until the account carries the transport charge for that recovery, dated on or after its repossession date. Put the other way: on an involuntary recovery whose account does not yet carry a transport charge dated on or after the repossession date, no deficiency figure is stated; a voluntary surrender has no such condition.

### Issuing the quote: `quote_deficiency_balance_4c162eac`

An agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `quote_deficiency_balance_4c162eac` and then calls it with the figure already worked out; the tool records the figure as given and judges no eligibility.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `preowned_contract_id` | the reference number of the pre-owned contract being quoted, as returned by the pre-owned contract lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `amount` | the quoted deficiency amount in US dollars | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half-up to the cent |

**Effect.** On success one payoff quote for the customer is recorded on the contract, dated today, with the stated amount and a good-through date ten calendar days from today; balances and status do not change. The customer can be told the quoted amount and the good-through date from the receipt.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the quote reference (an opaque id beginning with "pqt_"), the contract reference, the quoted amount in US dollars with 2 decimals, the quote date and the good-through date (both YYYY-MM-DD). The presence of the quote reference shows the quote was recorded.
